meta.description: Best known bounds on K_q(n,R), the minimum size of a q-ary covering code of length n and covering radius R.

primary_source.author: Gerzson Keri
primary_source.title: Tables for bounds on covering codes

lower_bound_updates.title: Semidefinite lower bounds for covering codes
lower_bound_updates.note: Improvements are LOWER bounds only; they never move an upper bound. The paper treats q in {2,3,4,5} exclusively -- q >= 6 is untouched. Their SDP also gives K_5(11,5) >= 100, which does not beat Keri.
